Class ChessMoveValidator

java.lang.Object
chess.app.ChessMoveValidator
public class ChessMoveValidator extends Object
ChessMoveValidator.java Controls input, prevents duplicate piece types, creates five Figure objects and a separate Bishop, checks their moves, and displays results. Authors: Aredth Sanchez, Sofia Vargas, Ben Silva
Since:
2026-10-20

    • isDuplicatePiece

      public static boolean isDuplicatePiece(Figure[] pieceArray, Bishop bishop, ChessPieceType piece)
      Checks the Figure array and separate Bishop for a previously selected type.
      Parameters:
      pieceArray - array of Figure objects already collected; unfilled elements may be null.
      bishop - separate Bishop object, or null if it has not been collected.
      piece - piece type to check for duplication.
      Returns:
      true if the type has already been selected; false otherwise.

    • createPiece

      public static Figure createPiece(ChessPieceType pieceType, ChessColor color, LocationX column, int row)
      Creates a Figure subclass for the selected type; Bishop is created separately in main.
      Parameters:
      pieceType - selected chess piece type.
      color - piece color as a ChessColor value.
      column - column of the position as a LocationX value.
      row - row number of the position.
      Returns:
      A Pawn, Rook, Knight, King, or Queen object as a Figure.
      Throws:
      InvalidPieceException - type is null, BISHOP, or otherwise unsupported.
      InvalidCoordinateException - starting coordinates are invalid.
      IllegalArgumentException - color is null.

    • printMoveResult

      public static void printMoveResult(String description, LocationX targetColumn, int targetRow, boolean result)
      Displays the piece description, target position, and movement result.
      Parameters:
      description - readable description of the piece.
      targetColumn - destination column as a LocationX value.
      targetRow - destination row number.
      result - true for a valid move; false for an invalid move.
